Mara (AE): Heads-up — FinReg Corp returned our vendor risk packet. They specifically asked for: a simple data-flow diagram showing where PII touches anything, a CSV of subprocessors and what data each sees, confirmation whether any runtime caches are persisted to disk, options for customer-managed keys during a POC, and if we can support pseudonymization pre-ingest. POC kickoff scheduled Tue morning. Can we turn this around quickly?

Omar (Solutions Eng): Quick answers while I gather artifacts: hosted API processes in-region (they picked eu-west-1) and by default our inference runtime keeps KV/prefix cache in-memory only. We do have an optional disk-backed cache for Dedicated; that would be explicit in the deployment config. No automatic cross-region replication unless routing configured.

Jin (Infra): Control plane metadata (routing rules, tenant config) is managed in our control plane region. Audit logs go to encrypted S3 with default 90d retention. For Dedicated we can offer S3 in customer account or longer retention. Third-party infra subprocessors to flag: CloudHost EU (compute), ObjectStorePro (metrics/archives), TelemetryQueue (alerts). I will export a formal CSV.

SecurityBot: SIG checklist snippet — encryption at rest: AES-256; KMS: customer-managed keys supported for Dedicated/Private (BYOK); hosted supports envelope encryption with Redwood-managed CMKs. Network: TLS in transit, VPC peering for Private. RBAC: OAuth + role mapping. Incident response: ir@redwood.example.

Omar (Solutions Eng): For pseudonymization, recommend client-side tokenization/hashing for direct identifiers for the POC. Example snippet I usually share: 
```
# python pseudonymize example
import hashlib
def pseudonymize(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(value.encode()).hexdigest()
```
That avoids shipping raw SSNs/emails. I can also add a Node/Go middleware if they prefer.

Ella (Legal): We'll need the subprocessor CSV and a redacted data-flow PNG to attach to the DPA. Also, confirm log retention windows and whether any diagnostic snapshots (core dumps, kernel logs) could contain payloads — those are not collected in Hosted by default. If they request key access details for BYOK, we need contract amendments plus SSO binding for key rotation responsibilities.

Mara (AE): Can Omar/Jin assemble: 1) one-page data-flow PNG (annotated, redacted), 2) subprocessors.csv with service role and region, 3) one-paragraph KMS/BYOK explanation, and 4) a short pricing delta for Dedicated + BYOK for the POC. Need by EOD so Legal can run the DPA before Monday.

Omar (Solutions Eng): I'll draft the diagram and KMS blurb. Draft assets (internal link): https://redwood.internal/diagrams/finreg-poc-datapath-v1.png. Subproc CSV preview: CloudHost EU, eu-west-1, compute; ObjectStorePro, eu-west-1, metrics/archive; TelemetryQueue, eu-central-1, alerting. I'll produce the formal CSV and a minimal sequence of hops: client -> edge-ingress eu-west-1 -> inference pool (AZ-local) -> optionally object store for logs -> control plane (metadata).

Jin (Infra): Pricing ballpark for planning: small Dedicated pool ~ $12k/mo, BYOK integration +$2k/mo, one-time setup/config ~$4k. If they want private control plane or on-prem, that's a different line item.

Ella (Legal): Sounds good. If FinReg will accept hashed identifiers for the POC, that reduces legal exposure. If they insist on raw PII examples, escalate to Private/on-prem discussion.

Mara (AE): Thanks all — I'll send the bundle with the caveat about pseudonymization and the provisional pricing. I'll push for a signed DPA before exchanging any sensitive diagrams. :thumbsup:
